verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents concurrency tiers explicitly: 10 concurrent browsers free, 50 after a $100 top-up, and 250/500/1,000 at higher paid totals. It also documents programmatic browser lifecycle (launch a cloud browser, connect over CDP, stop it), reusable sessions holding multiple runs, and a published v4 OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: detailed fleet-level session management docs (listing and bulk control of many concurrent sessions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of running at scale.
